Before buying a second-hand watch, ensure your watch's reference number matches with your watch, and secondly ensure your movement has been used by the manufacturer for your reference number. These two checks are not enough but are the main points of a verification..

At Mainspring, we make all the required and detailed inspections before we buy a watch to display in our store and present to our customers. 
We issue a store authenticity liability certificate with each watch we sell and also provide 3 months warranty.

Patek Phillipe Twenty~4 Ladies - Complete Set

Ref. 4910-1200A/001
Year : 2025
Size: 25mm x 30mm
Movement : Calibre E15- Quartz

Diamonds: 36pcs brillant-cut total 0,47ct

Complete Set: 
Its a complete set inclusive of the watch (in its original condition) and its full bracelet, 
its certificate in a PP leather certificate case, 
display box in a dust bag, books and outbox. 

Also we will issue a store authenticiy liability certificate for a peace of mind purchase.

Price : 59,500dhs 

PP named the watch "Twenty~4" to explicitly market it as a companion for all 24 hours of the day
—seamlessly transitioning 
from casual morning wear to business meetings, and finally to a formal evening gown.

The Caliber E15 quartz movement is made entirely in-house by Patek Philippe 
at their manufacture in Geneva, Switzerland.

Unlike many other luxury watch brands that outsource their quartz movements to 
third-party mass manufacturers (like ETA or Ronda)
Patek Philippe designs, builds, and finishes its quartz calibers to the same exacting standards 
as its high-end mechanical movements.

You can view the watch at our store in The B1 Mall (behind MoE) daily open between 01:30PM and 11:00PM.

A Curated Selection of Longines — By Mainspring 

Founded in 1832 in Saint-Imier, Switzerland, Longines has built a legacy of precision, refined craftsmanship, and timeless elegance. 
With nearly two centuries of watchmaking heritage, the maison remains a symbol of understated luxury.

Mainspring presents a carefully curated collection of Longines timepieces, each reflecting the brand’s enduring design philosophy.

The Collection:
